apps.name: Generic self-hosted app
apps.summary: Base runbook and registry schema for any self-hosted app: install-if-missing, persistence, safe restore, gated upgrades.

apps.name: Tailscale
apps.summary: Keeps the same node identity across resets, owner login choice, shared Taildrop inbox with opt-in retention.

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.summary: Newest stable from GitHub, durable device ID/DB/folders, owner-confirmed pairing, never auto-accepts devices or folders.

apps.name: Resilio Sync
apps.summary: Headless Resilio Sync 3.x: signed-chain install, durable-first persistence incl. databases (clean-stop cold copy), owner-confirmed identity pairing, secret-safe web API helper, health and log cap.

scripts.purpose: Read-only sanity validator for the app-management registry and records; prints REFUSE/WARN/OK findings, never prints secrets. Exit 2 REFUSE, 1 unconfirmed WARN, 0 clean.

Secret-safe client for Resilio's undocumented local web API (python3, no dependencies): token/cookie/basic auth handled internally; read commands (status, folders, peers, license, settings, advanced, history, version), safe writes (pause, resume, rescan, rename-device, whitelisted settings, selective sync, folder prefs) and guarded risky ones (add-folder, remove-folder need explicit flags). Filters keys, tokens and ids; caps output.
Resilio health check for the daily check: process, loopback port, unauthenticated 401, authenticated status, licence, peers and per-folder summary. Prints non-secret fields only; exit 0 healthy.

Installs the Resilio Sync binary only if missing (never upgrades) through a signed chain: pinned vendor key fingerprint, signed InRelease, Packages and .deb hashes, binary identical to the CDN tarball's, version string check. Version from RESILIO_VERSION or the record's installed_version.
Caps Resilio's own log at about 1 MiB when over 5 MiB, truncating in place (no restart, mode 600, no rotated copies). Touches only the record's log_path.

Resilio restore helper for restore-guard (record key restore_helper): durable-first. Changes nothing when live state is present and every database passes integrity_check (on temp copies); otherwise moves it aside and restores one consistent set from the cold copy (databases only from a clean-stop copy). Exit 3 = nothing usable anywhere.

Restore safeguards: preflight (optionally delegating to an app's restore_helper), link (moves existing items aside), rollback, commit, prune (max two leftovers per path, never in-use items). Never deletes or overwrites existing data.

Resilio cold-copy helper: light refresh while running (config, settings, sync.dat, identity, licence, login secret) or --with-db (clean stop, copies every database and each folder's .sync metadata, cmp-verifies, restarts). Max two copies; refuses unsafe, synced or unmarked destinations.

Resilio Sync launcher: refuses unknown arguments, exits 0 at once when the web UI answers, starts fully detached (setsid nohup, own session, inherited fds closed, umask 077 so the log is mode 600) and waits for it; installs, upgrades and restores nothing; never touches the databases; manages only Resilio.

Syncthing start launcher: refuses unknown arguments, exits 0 at once when healthy, starts fully detached (setsid nohup, own session, inherited fds closed) and waits for health; installs/upgrades nothing, re-seeds identity only if missing, never touches the DB, runs with --no-upgrade and optional memory caps; keeps Syncthing's monitor; manages only Syncthing. Rollback guard: only when the DB is older than the kernel boot (and an optional platform boot marker agrees), starts sendreceive folders receiveonly and a detached worker reverts stale changes, keeps post-boot edits as conflict copies, restores the folder types; leaves receiveonly plus a flag if it can't finish; keeps at most two run dirs.
Syncthing cold-copy helper: essentials only (cert/key/config), max two dirs, only when healthy; refuses unsafe, synced, DB, or unmarked destinations.
Retention cleanup for the marked Taildrop inbox only; deletes files older than taildrop_retention_days; refuses unsafe, synced, unmarked, or state-holding dirs.
Moves received Taildrop files into a marked shared inbox under durable_root; optional idempotent --loop; refuses unsafe, synced, or unmarked dirs.

Tailscale launcher: refuses unknown arguments, installs only if missing (never upgrades), re-seeds state from cold copy, starts tailscaled detached (own session), treats NeedsLogin as a failed restore, refreshes the cold copy when healthy; manages only Tailscale.
